label: Keep Awake
description: Keep the computer awake while agents work. Add a timer, or keep the display on too.

label: Pause to Read
description: Freeze the terminal view to read the output. The Session keeps running in the background.

label: Task Favorites
description: Star the Tasks that matter, so priority work is easy to spot in the Project.

label: Developer Notes
description: Keep a small checklist beside each Task and tick off the checks as you finish them.

label: Notifications
description: Choose which input requests and review alerts reach your desktop, iPhone and Apple Watch.

label: Appearance
description: Choose Light, Dark or System. Your terminal panes follow the workspace theme.
